ev_per_mw_usd_m.pivot_premium_mechanic: announcing a hyperscaler-anchored AI hosting deal (e.g. Core Scientific-CoreWeave, Jun 2024) re-rates a miner from pure-mining EV/MW (~$0.3-1M/MW) toward the $3-12M/MW hosting-conversion band, with further re-rating toward $20-27M/MW as the deal is de-risked/energized/delivered and becomes investment-grade backed. This 8-14 cents-on-the-dollar gap between announced and stabilized value is the single best-sourced 'why sign contracts early' mechanic in this whole pack.

backlog_weight_pct_of_remaining_revenue.source: 18-act-ii-design.md §8/§14 -- CONFIRMED as game value; no contradicting real-world data found (backlog-quality-weighted valuation is a design abstraction, not something companies report this way, but it is a reasonable simplification of how the market visibly prices CoreWeave/Nebius backlog differently by counterparty)

hyperscale_nnn_100mw_plus.source: maxlifedevelopment.com 2026 benchmarks (sourced): hyperscale NNN 5.00-5.50% by 2026; powered-shell stabilized 5.25-6.00%; wholesale colo 5.50-6.25%. DESIGN FLAG: 18-act-ii-design.md §7.3 assumed cap rates WIDEN in 2026 (6.5-7.5%) for the credit-squeeze narrative, but real 2023-2026 cap rates COMPRESSED steadily (asset class maturing, demand certainty rising) to ~5.25% by Sep2026. Recommended fix: keep compression through 2025-2026Q3, and model the widening the design wants as landing specifically in the 2026Q4 'aftershock' quarter (Oracle force majeure + DDTL spread widening triggering a real, if short, repricing) rather than across all of 2026.
